subject: Urgent: price correction + temporary credit — need expedited legal review
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Legal Review <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@aihealth.com>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Urgent: price correction + temporary credit — need expedited legal review

Marissa / Karthik —

Quick background: AI Health just surfaced a pricing clerical error in the finalized order form (exhibit A). Their procurement team needs an updated order form and a short credit for the overcharge period (estimated $9.3k). They are asking for legal signoff ASAP so they can process the invoice and keep the Q2 cutover on track.

Attached: proposed order form with tracked changes (AIHealth_proposed_orderform_redline_v1.docx) and a 1-page redline summary. The change is limited: correction to throughput band pricing and a one-time credit line. No SLA changes.

Ask: can legal expedite a short amendment (change order) template that:
- applies the corrected rate (effective date 2026-05-01)
- includes the one-time credit line and instruction for invoice reissue
- avoids broad new terms; keep it narrowly scoped to pricing and credit

Timeline: Marta indicated procurement needs legal approval by end of day Friday PT to hit their payment window. If we can turn a marked-up amendment by Thursday EOD PT that would be ideal.

Marta — tagging you so you see the proposed edits and the credit amount we calculated. If anything here is off, flag it.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0192

Attachments: AIHealth_proposed_orderform_redline_v1.docx (docx), redlines_summary_table.pdf (pdf)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 13:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: price correction + temporary credit — need expedited legal review

Thanks Steph — I reviewed the attachments quickly. High-level comments:
1) Narrow amendment language is fine, but we need a one-sentence affirmation that no other terms are changed ("Except as set forth herein, the MSA and Order Form remain in full force").
2) For the credit, we should specify whether it's a "billing credit" or "waiver" and include an expiration for application to invoices (e.g., within 60 days).
3) Procurement may ask for retroactive effective date language — that's fine but call out tax/billing implications in a short clause.

I'll draft a tight change-order template focusing only on the rate correction + one-time credit and a single sentence of non-waiver/non-amendment boilerplate. If Karthik has commercial tweaks, loop them in.

I can produce a redline by tomorrow (Thu) mid-day PT. If you need faster, I can do a minimal "temporary credit confirmation" note to lock procurement while we finalize the amend.

Marissa Cole
Sr. Counsel, Commercial Transactions
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

---- Original attachment note ----
AIHealth_proposed_orderform_redline_v1.docx (docx)
redlines_summary_table.pdf (pdf)

From: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@aihealth.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@aihealth.com
Date: Thu, 21 May 2026 08:30:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: price correction + temporary credit — need expedited legal review

Hi Stephanie —

Thanks for the quick flag. The $9.3k credit amount looks right on our side; procurement can accept a short-form amendment and a corrected invoice. If Redwood can provide a short "credit confirmation" email we can use that immediately while your legal team completes the formal change order.

Our payment run is next Monday (May 25) — if we have the confirmation and the corrected invoice by COB Friday we can include it. If not, we'll need to push to the following run and it delays their implementation.

Appreciate the expedited help.

—Marta
Marta Lopez
Head of Procurement, AI Health
marta.lopez@aihealth.com
+1 617-555-0268

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@aihealth.com>
Date: Fri, 22 May 2026 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Final: short-form amendment + credit confirmation (DEAL-4821)

All —

Attached is a concise change order (two paragraphs) implementing the corrected throughput rates (effective 2026-05-01) and documenting a one-time billing credit of $9,300 to be applied to the May invoice. Key points:
- The amendment expressly states it does not modify other MSA terms.
- Credit application: Redwood will issue a corrected invoice within five business days after this amendment is countersigned by both parties.
- Tax language: buyer is responsible for any tax consequences; seller (Redwood) notifies if tax reclassification required.

Marta, if this text is acceptable, please reply-all with an approval line and we'll route for signature (DocuSign link provided below). If you need us to produce a separate one-line confirmation email first, I can send that immediately.

DocuSign: https://docusign.example/sign/DEAL-4821-placeholder

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Counsel, Commercial Transactions
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Attachments: AIHealth_change_order_shortform_v1.pdf (pdf), redlines_summary_table.pdf (pdf)
